clinical.citation: Clinical characteristics and genetic analysis of four pediatric patients with Kleefstra syndrome (PMID: 39696517)

variants.description: De novo terminal 9q34 deletion including EHMT1

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Novel splice variant and previously reported missense variant identified by exome sequencing and Sanger validation; de novo 9q deletion. The fourth patient had a KMT2C variant (KLEFS2), not EHMT1.

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Classified as VUS, associated with Kleefstra syndrome

model_organism.citation: Hepatic/forebrain study: Ehmt1 D6Cre/+ - Impairments in sensory-motor gating and information processing in a mouse model of Ehmt1 haploinsufficiency (PMID: 32954001)
phenotypes: Complete absence of object recognition memory
Reduced magnitude of auditory evoked potentials (paired-pulse inhibition and mismatch negativity)
Reduced beta- and gamma-band oscillatory activity
Reduced Grin1 mRNA expression in hippocampus, suggesting NMDA-R disruption

model_organism.citation: Haploinsufficiency of EHMT1 improves pattern separation and increases hippocampal cell proliferation (PMID: 28071689)
phenotypes: Unimpaired visual discrimination and reversal learning, paired-associates learning and extinction learning in touchscreen tasks
Enhanced performance on Location Discrimination (pattern separation)
Increased BrdU-labelled cells in the subgranular zone of the dentate gyrus (increased adult hippocampal cell proliferation)

model_organism.citation: Defensive and offensive behaviours in a Kleefstra syndrome mouse model (PMID: 36877418)
phenotypes: Defensive postures, attacking and biting toward unfamiliar conspecifics in host-visitor tests
Ehmt1+/- animals were the most aggressive and always initiated fights with WT mice
Anxiety, autistic-like traits and aberrant social interactions with non-cagemates (background)

model_organism.citation: Re-establishment of H3K9me2 eliminates the transcriptional inhibition of ST18 on meiotic genes and orchestrates female germ cell development (PMID: 40650982)
phenotypes: Zygotene arrest of meiosis in embryonic germ cells
Downregulated expression of key meiotic genes
Disrupted H3K9me2 re-establishment and ST18 expression homeostasis

model_organism.citation: The Histone Methyltransferases EHMT1 and EHMT2 Repress the Expression of Genes Related to Excitability and Cell Death in Oligodendrocyte Progenitors (PMID: 40134232)
phenotypes: Lineage-specific double ablation of Ehmt1 and Ehmt2 in oligodendrocyte lineage
Higher levels of cholinergic muscarinic receptors
Lower levels of myelin basic protein (MBP)
Cultured OPCs with Ehmt1/Ehmt2 deletion showed derepression of cell death and excitability genes

model_organism.citation: Euchromatin histone methyltransferase 1 regulates cortical neuronal network development (PMID: 27767173)
phenotypes: Impaired neural network activity during transition from uncorrelated firing to synchronized network bursting
Transiently reduced spontaneous bursting and excitatory synaptic currents
Less regular network bursting patterns later in development

model_organism.citation: The H3K9 dimethyltransferases EHMT1/2 protect against pathological cardiac hypertrophy (PMID: 27893464)
phenotypes: Genetic or miR-217-mediated inactivation of EHMT1/2 promoted pathological cardiac hypertrophy
Loss of H3K9me2 in pathological hypertrophy

biological.citation: An epigenetic barrier sets the timing of human neuronal maturation (PMID: 38297124)
biological.summary: In hPSC-derived cortical neurons, transient inhibition of EHMT1/EHMT2 (together with EZH2 or DOT1L) at the progenitor stage primed newly born neurons to mature precociously. EHMT1 is part of an epigenetic barrier that holds maturation programmes in a poised state and sets the pace of human neuronal maturation.

biological.citation: Comprehensive EHMT1 variants analysis broadens genotype-phenotype associations and molecular mechanisms in Kleefstra syndrome (PMID: 39013458)
biological.summary: Analysis of EHMT1 variants showed that disrupting the ankyrin repeat 'reader' domain gives a KLEFS1-specific DNA methylation signature and a milder phenotype. Disrupting only the SET-domain 'writer' methyltransferase activity does not give the signature or the typical phenotype. N-terminal truncating variants also give a mild phenotype without the signature.

biological.citation: Cell consequences of loss of function of the epigenetic factor EHMT1 (PMID: 37257768)
biological.summary: EHMT1 depletion in RPE1 cells altered Golgi, lysosome and cell adhesion structures. It also increased centriolar satellite detection and reduced cell migration, suggesting a role in centrosome function and cell motility.

biological.citation: EHMT1 regulates Parvalbumin-positive interneuron development and GABAergic input in sensory cortical areas (PMID: 32975655)
biological.summary: Ehmt1+/- mice show delayed maturation of PV+ interneurons in sensory cortices. They also show delayed GABAergic transmission maturation and reduced GABA release probability at putative PV+ synapses in auditory cortex, shifting the excitatory-inhibitory balance toward overexcitability.

biological.citation: EHMT1 promotes tumor progression and maintains stemness by regulating ALDH1A1 expression in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (PMID: 34897678)
biological.summary: EHMT1 is expressed in primary and relapse ARMS tumors. Its knockdown impaired motility, induced differentiation, reduced xenograft tumor progression and downregulated ALDH1A1. EHMT1 activates the ALDH1A1 promoter indirectly, by stabilizing C/EBPβ rather than binding the promoter.

biological.citation: Disruption of an EHMT1-associated chromatin-modification module causes intellectual disability (PMID: 22726846)
biological.summary: De novo mutations in MBD5, MLL3, SMARCB1 and NR1I3 were found in patients with a Kleefstra syndrome-like phenotype. In Drosophila, MBD5, MLL3 and NR1I3 genetically cooperate with EHMT1, placing EHMT1 in a conserved chromatin-modification network underlying cognition.

biological.citation: ASHG 2011 - Identification of three novel genes for Kleefstra syndrome associated phenotypes establishes a chromatin modification module of the EHMT1 gene network
biological.summary: Drosophila EHMT1 disruption caused impaired neurodevelopment and learning and memory defects. Genetic interaction studies with the three novel chromatin-modifier genes showed reciprocal modulation of mutant phenotypes, supporting functional interaction within an EHMT1 module.

biological.citation: Impairments in sensory-motor gating and information processing in a mouse model of Ehmt1 haploinsufficiency (PMID: 32954001)
biological.summary: Forebrain-specific Ehmt1 D6Cre/+ mice show abnormal sensory-motor gating, absent object recognition memory, and reduced auditory evoked potentials and beta/gamma oscillations. Grin1 mRNA is reduced in hippocampus, suggesting NMDA receptor disruption.

biological.citation: Analysis of EHMT1 expression and its correlations with clinical significance in esophageal squamous cell cancer (PMID: 24649311)
biological.summary: EHMT1 is upregulated in ESCC and in preinvasive squamous lesions compared with normal epithelium (52.0% vs 21.7%). Expression correlates with tumor grade, invasion depth and lymph node metastasis, and is an independent prognostic factor for poor survival.
biological.sample_size: 50 ESCC cases and 46 paired normal tissues

biological.citation: BRD4 acts as a transcriptional repressor of RhoB to inhibit terminal erythropoiesis (PMID: 40598222)
biological.summary: BRD4 interacts with the histone methyltransferase EHMT1/2 (shown by Co-IP and ChIP-qPCR). Through this interaction it acts as a transcriptional repressor of RhoB and inhibits terminal erythroid maturation.
